concepts.gloss_en: The brazenness/insolence of the body, an aspect of the Other Side (sitra achra)
The breaking/shattering of the body's brazenness (an action performed upon 'עזות הגוף', not the thing itself)

notes: Rule 4: an action/state about X is not X. 'משבר עזות הגוף' (breaking the body's brazenness, via holy audacity/cries) is a distinct action-concept from 'עזות הגוף' (the body's brazenness itself, an aspect of the sitra achra). Token overlap only; kept separate.
